warnings: Added 2026-10-23 (op04 resume): views 3-4 of S-02 were left unextracted on 2026-10-19. The HC block is recorded as one precast_plank_detail entry with element_id 'HC' - the same mark the S-02/S-03 slab plans print on every hollow-core field, so it joins as their spec.

Plank thickness is printed '0.80-0.10 m.' twice (beside both plank sections) - read as a misprint of 0.08-0.10 (an 0.80 m plank is impossible next to the 0.60/1.20 widths and S-07's 'พื้นสำเร็จรูปหนา 0.10ม.'); thickness_mm_printed_as keeps the print, thickness_mm is left null rather than choosing 80 or 100.
The two ledge details carry no mark (G6 / B7-B8-B11 print the same ledge on S-10 / S-07), so they are connection_detail entries with element_id null.
Boxed note 'ห้ามนำพื้นชนิดแผ่นตันมาใช้ในการก่อสร้าง' (solid planks forbidden) kept in printed_text.
